players.product: Baidu AI Cloud Infra (GPU cloud and CPU cloud, Qianfan MaaS platform) built on proprietary Kunlunxin AI chips (M100, upcoming M300), plus ERNIE foundation models

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (Exhibit 99.1), segment revenue: AI Cloud Infra revenue was RMB 7.3 billion, up 50% year over year (Q1 2026: RMB 8.8 billion; down 17% quarter over quarter); AI Applications revenue RMB 2.5 billion, up 3% year over year; AI-native marketing services RMB 2.6 billion, approximately flat year over year; Baidu Core AI-powered Business RMB 12.5 billion, up 25% year over year. Legacy Business was RMB 10.4 billion (down 23% year over year) and Online Marketing Services RMB 13.1 billion (down 19% year over year, up 4% quarter over quarter; 52% of Baidu General Business). The release says GPU Cloud revenue was previously referred to as subscription-based revenue from AI accelerator infrastructure, and that its growth reflected mounting demand for public cloud-based AI computing.
quarterly_data.figure: AI Cloud Infra RMB 7.3 billion (+50% YoY; Q1 2026 RMB 8.8 billion, -17% QoQ); AI Applications RMB 2.5 billion (+3%); AI-native marketing services RMB 2.6 billion (~flat); Online Marketing Services RMB 13.1 billion (-19% YoY); Legacy Business RMB 10.4 billion (-23%)

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (Exhibit 99.1), cash flow statement: capital expenditures of Baidu, Inc. were RMB 11,390 million (US$1,679 million) in the three months ended June 30, 2026, versus RMB 5,916 million in the three months ended March 31, 2026 and RMB 3,800 million in the three months ended June 30, 2025 (Baidu excluding iQIYI: RMB 11,370 million). Free cash flow was negative RMB 7,954 million (US$1,173 million). CFO Haijian He: operating cash flow remained positive for the fourth consecutive quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 capex RMB 11,390 million (US$1,679 million); Q1 2026 RMB 5,916 million; Q2 2025 RMB 3,800 million; free cash flow RMB (7,954) million

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results release (Exhibit 99.1), operations: Apollo Go's global footprint has reached 28 cities and its fleets have accumulated over 350 million autonomous kilometers, including over 240 million fully driverless autonomous kilometers. Apollo Go signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Kazakhstan's Turlov Private Holding Ltd. to jointly explore autonomous ride-hailing services in that country. Baidu launched an enterprise edition of DuMate, its general-purpose agent for everyday productivity, in June 2026, and Baidu App's monthly active users reached 644 million in June 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Apollo Go in 28 cities; over 350 million autonomous km (over 240 million fully driverless); Baidu App MAU 644 million
